items.text: Checklist: the mandatory tasks count goes back to 0 (shown as ~0 / 5) after the daily reset at 09:00 German time, and the first login of a day no longer takes yesterday's count; after Stacy's fork

Website: the encounter's player lists show the iDPS next to the total damage in every row and get an iDPS switch beside Damage and Healing; "Best DPS" on the boss pages is now called "Best iDPS", which is what the number is
Titles: the 18 achievement titles of the G_ rows (Journey's Path and others) get their names, they showed as Title 13051004 on profiles
Windows: the X and the minimize line of the title bars are drawn with room for their stroke, so the cross is no longer cut off on some display scalings

Windows: the tools window stays on its second monitor when another tool is chosen (it was pulled back to the first monitor); a saved place on a monitor that is not connected puts the window on monitor 1 and asks once whether to overwrite the saved places or keep them for the next start

Tools: pop out button right of the overlay switch shows a tool in a window of its own that can go anywhere, also on a second monitor; place and open state are kept and the windows come back at the next start
pop out windows for the tools with an overlay switch, the tools window stays on a second monitor, saved window places on a monitor that is gone fall back to monitor 1
Profile arcana: the lord value shows for all ten lords (ids 13-17 were missing on the website)
Arcana: pieces whose login entry has one extra zero byte after the size field are read again (they showed no experience, lord or skills)
Selftest: arcana entry with one extra zero byte behind the size field
arcana pieces with a shifted login entry show their experience, lord and skills again, and the website shows the lord value for all ten lords
Twitch Drops page: the running and upcoming campaigns are listed newest first, like the past ones
Pet knowledge: Regeneration, Perfection and the resist and penetration stats get their names, and Damage Amplification and HP + show as percent instead of raw numbers
Server matchmaking: South America is read as LATAM (its pairs no longer land in NA West), the Abyss pairings with both factions are stored in their own table
Skill presets: the short preset switch frame is read and a preset's skill list replaces its stigmas, so every preset shows only its own four stigmas with their levels
Skill stones: the five stones are the game's own stigma icons, one set per class with its emblem, all cut to the same size so they no longer look different

NC matching: the workers never sit idle - the queue is topped up every 15 seconds, first with the players that are due, then with the ones NC looked at longest ago (confirmed players too), so renames and server transfers show up as soon as possible
Partner API: pets and wings carry the URL of their picture; all 207 pet portraits from the game client

Settings: a Privacy block under Upload shows whether the privacy policy is accepted and opens it again to read and to accept or decline; the close and minimize buttons of the settings window are drawn lines like in the other windows, the cross was too big
Settings: input field for how many seconds the boss stays shown after its death (auto boss view)
Website: footer links to the DPS meter guide
input field for the seconds the current boss stays shown after its death, privacy block in settings, NC matching never idles, pet and wing pictures in the partner API

Website: the terms sections and the FAQ answers on the home and download pages have anchors (for example /terms#game-rules and /download#faq-safe), and a page opened with such an anchor jumps to that place

NC requests: the 15 s timeout now starts when a request is really sent and not while it waits in the shared queue, so at a wide gap the later workers no longer time out before they are sent, which had counted as network errors, kept the gap at its maximum and failed almost every request

NC matching: players NC has looked at and could not confirm now have their own status 'unmatched', and 'client' only means his client named a server and NC has not looked yet; a player found elsewhere on another server is moved there only when that character is at least at the level we saw him at
Dummy test and Skill Assist: the opacity label and the percent sign of the overlay take the app's text colour instead of the Windows default

Twitch Drops: the Halloween campaign is found again after NC changed the notice layout (heading without colon, period under Event Schedule), and its Chubby Panda reward shows its picture and the game's own name in every language

new setting "Show the current boss automatically": while a boss is attacked the table shows only the damage on that boss, 10 seconds after its death it returns to everything, and everything is recorded all the time

Website: the how it works article explains how frames become a combat log and how uploads and leaderboards work (what is sent, what the server accepts, why the data says nothing about the person behind a character), and the FAQ gives the real data rate of a recording

Website: the how it works article shows two diagrams in the page itself, the way of a packet from the network adapter to the combat log and the TCP hole that never fills, in all ten languages and in both themes

Website: the how it works article quotes the data rate measured over 54 recordings (about 93 hours of play: 3 KB per second on average, about 260 KB in the busiest second) instead of one five-minute recording

Website: the how it works article says that the data volume was not what overran the capture buffer: the 47 world boss fights in our recordings (up to 702 players) peaked at about 164 segments and 48 KB per second
Website: the terms section on game rules links to NCSOFT's operating policy and terms of service, in all ten languages, and legal texts can now contain links
Website: the home FAQ answer on whether Aion DPS is allowed is shortened to a length similar to the other answers, in all ten languages and in the server-rendered FAQ

Boss health: the 6.5 % health cut of Transcendence stages 1 and 2 (Deus Research Base and Shattered Arkanis) is taken over, so the new spawn values count as the whole boss and kills there stay whole fights instead of turning into partial fights

NC matching: the same four workers that fetch the character data now also do the player matches, at the pace they have learned, and a worker with nothing due takes players whose retry is not due yet instead of sitting idle
Website: the Pantheon has its own tab on the profile page instead of sharing the Arcana tab (which already holds the set effect, the god values, three cards and the skill bonus sum)

Website: the how it works article says up front what NCSOFT's rules sanction and where the tool stands (no more claim that it is safe), and gets a questions section; the FAQ on the home and download pages now answers "Is it allowed?" in all ten languages

Website: the Pantheon tab draws the Pantheon as a ring like the game's window (twelve paintings on the outer ring, four statues in hexagons, the colossus in the middle, with the game's icons and the frame colour of each decoration's grade), with the effects and details beside it

Own position: without a fresh exact report the middle of the entities around is the trimmed one (only those within 45 m of the median) instead of the mean - monsters announced 2 to 3 km away pulled the mean 479 m off in the median on the Insel der Ewigkeit, the trimmed middle is 15 m off

Verteron map: the offset correction of 12 October is taken back - with it only 62 % of the spawn points of the Insel der Ewigkeit lay on land (monsters and cubes drawn in the sea, the player 80 m east and 115 m north of the arrow), without it 98 %

the own position without a fresh exact report is no longer pulled away by monsters announced far away, and the Verteron map is shifted back so that monsters and cubes on the Insel der Ewigkeit are no longer drawn in the sea

World boss rule: the rifts follow the local time of the region (Europe: 02:00, 05:00 ... 23:00 Central European Time; NA East and West in US time), so they move an hour in UTC when the clocks change - until now the clock was fixed to UTC and from 25.10. the paired server of a kill in a rift hour was taken for a stranger; the ten minutes of tail after a rift are gone again (the paired server is on the map for exactly one hour)
Tests: the test of the world boss rift hours in the estimated-fights file follows the local-time schedule of the rifts

Player servers in world boss kills: a faction the game gave a player whose server was read wrongly counts as wrong with the server (an Asmodian on an Elyos server in an Elyos home kill is filed on the home server with its faction), contradicting kills are decided by the newest one, and the kills a client filed under the wrong row of a name move to the row on the right server

Game menu detection: clicks, the mouse wheel and keys pressed inside an open menu no longer bring the overlays back (only the show-cursor key held before the cursor shows is a peek), and after a click the menu state lasts 1.5 s while the game swaps the cursor for its click glow

Pantheon: the own Pantheon (the decorations set up in its three presets and every registered decoration) is read at login and when the Pantheon window changes, uploaded with the own profile and shown on the profile page with the effects added up (in the arcana tab, which is now called Arcana & Pantheon); the privacy text names it, so everybody who accepted is asked once more (privacy version 2)

Website and READMEs: the answers on whether the tool is allowed (home and download FAQ, the features article, the READMEs in all languages) now say what NCSOFT's rules sanction and what Aion DPS does not do, instead of calling the tool legal and safe

the own Pantheon is read at login and sent with the profile, the game menu detection no longer lets clicks, the mouse wheel and keys inside an open menu bring the overlays back, and the privacy text names the Pantheon, so everybody who accepted is asked once more

Player servers: a character's server must fit the world boss fights he was in (only the uploader's own server, and in the Abyss and in rift hours also the server NC's matchmaking paired with it); a server a client names for a crowd player outside that is taken from him, a hit at NC on any other server counts as a namesake, and the characters found with a wrong server are moved to the one their fights allow

World boss rule: the other faction is still on the map for ten minutes after a rift hour, so its players on the paired server count as allowed in a kill that starts up to ten minutes after the hour (25.10., 16:03 UTC: 23 of 110 players were Asmodians of the paired server)

Player lookup at NC: a common name has far more hits than the pages read ("Pixie": 175), so a player whose crowd or fights leave one to three servers is now searched on those servers one by one (exact answer), the clean-up also takes a server of the other faction than the player's, and an unplaced player of a world boss crowd is no longer missed behind the hits of his namesakes

Server of a player in view: his own "player appeared" frame wins over every list entry (friends, legion, character window, party roster hold namesakes of the other side and other servers); until now such an entry could replace it, and a wrong but valid server went into the upload for 0.3 to 2 % of a world boss crowd
the server of a player in view now comes from his own frame and no list entry of a namesake can replace it any more (it put valid but wrong servers into the uploads of world boss crowds)

Character page, Arcana tab: for a character whose own client uploaded the details it shows each piece with its reinforcement experience and the limit, its god value and its four skill bonuses (tooltips name the final skill level and where it comes from), above them the set effect and the five lord values, and a column with the sum of all skill bonuses; the arcana have their names in the game's languages

with "upload my profile" the client now also sends the details of the arcana pieces it read at login (reinforcement experience, god value and skill bonuses of each piece), so the character page on the website can show them
Website: everything about the code signing application is removed (the Code Signing Policy page, its link and the note on the download page)
Website: the download page shows the installer's SHA-256 (with a copy button) and the VirusTotal result with a link to its report, read from the release notes
Download page: all its texts (requirements, FAQ, screenshots, checksum and VirusTotal lines) are translated into Spanish, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian and both Chinese

Website: the missing texts of the character, rankings, comparison, status, timeline and statistics pages are translated into Spanish, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian and both Chinese (game terms from the client's own texts where it has them)

Download page: new layout with the download card, a screenshot viewer and the latest client changes side by side, the five install steps and the FAQ as cards, and a ? next to the SHA-256 that explains what it is and how to check it on Windows (all texts in ten languages)

Website: boss pages with no fights and no mechanics guide, legions with fewer than three known members and characters without gear or a valid best run are kept out of the search index (Google rated them soft 404); such boss pages leave the sitemap
Download page: the FAQ heading is written out in every language (Frequently asked questions, Häufige Fragen, ...)
nginx: maintenance page in all ten site languages while the backend is down (503 + Retry-After, reloads itself, API paths keep the plain error); build script and notes in deploy/
Download page: copy buttons with a copy icon for the SHA-256 and the two check commands (the icon turns into a check mark after copying)
Download page: step 2 links to the Npcap download section (npcap.com has no direct latest link)
SEO: home page definition sentence, FAQ with FAQPage schema, GameApplication category, README tagline

Website: Aion DPS is now presented as the Daevas Power Suite, a companion app (new banner with the highlighted D, P, S, a FAQ row on the home page, the texts in ten languages and the READMEs no longer call it a meter)
Technical background page: says that every push runs the type check and all backend tests in public and builds the client, with a link to the test results (ten languages)

Home page: the banner is a picture slider with six pictures (Daevas Power Suite, live combat stats, boss, crafting, character, events), changing every 7 seconds with arrows and small squares, stopping under the mouse, each with a link to the matching part of the features page (ten languages)

Character window, Arcana tab: each piece shows its reinforcement experience with the limit from the game's table, its god value and its four skill bonuses (a tooltip names the final skill level and where it comes from), above them the set effect and the five god values, and a column with the sum of all skill bonuses
Character page: the Arcana tab now sits before the Ranks tab

the Arcana tab of the character window shows each piece's reinforcement experience, god value and four skill bonuses, the set effect, the five god values and the sum of all skill bonuses, with tooltips naming the final skill level and where it comes from

Runs wait less for NC's player check: the players of a normal upload are looked up before the hundreds of a world boss crowd and the background round, and the players a waiting run is held up by are sent to NC at once
Stage 4 of Deus Research Base (Atiel) and Shattered Arkanis (Talisra of the Void) is known: the runs are filed under Stage 4 instead of an unknown stage

Old uploads with a wrong server id no longer keep a run waiting for ever: a player NC has confirmed is not moved off his server by an upload, the place a character was wrongly filed under is remembered so a repeated upload finds him again, and an NC decision is not overwritten by a client's word on every upload
NC player check: the entry level of the content a run was in (Draupnir: 45) rules out characters of the same name that are too low to have been there
Crafting recipes: alchemy is profession 4 (proven by a recording, comment only)
Profile: NC's page extends every profile (skills, boards, title), replaces a game profile after 2 days and the player's own after 7 days (its own lists stay)
NC queue: two buckets - after every three normal jobs one background job, and the background keeps a quarter of the hourly budget
NC fetches: four players at the same time, one learned pace for all requests (starts at 2 s, shorter in small steps, longer again when 502s pile up, pause on 429/403), hourly budget 6000
NC pacing: a 429/403 counts once however many requests got it, and no job starts during the pause
NC sweep: players whose complete fetch was reset go first; hourly budget 9000
Feedback forwarding: GitHub calls are tried again after a timeout, a server error or the 'malformed request' on big recordings, and a stuck connection no longer hangs

Privacy question: closing the window without an answer is no answer - nothing is uploaded, the meter stays complete and the question comes again at the next start (it used to put the player in the restricted mode)
Website: the homepage banner's three ways in are big buttons with a line about what is behind them and an arrow, the footer no longer links the code signing policy
Website: the light theme is a step darker and has no card shadow, the effects-on-the-boss bars are easier to see in it

Effects on the boss: the monsters' own skills have their client names in every language, the poison of the client's damage over time is named, and a hidden effect without any name is no longer listed by its number
Downloads: the release carries SHA256SUMS.txt (installer and update packages) and the installer's SHA-256 in its notes; the download page says how to check it
Website: a run's page shows all bosses of the run as tabs above the damage list, so every fight of a run can be opened from one page

Twitch Drops page: the Ludra rewards show their pictures and the game's own names in every language (Battle Enhance Scroll, Artisan's Roasted Fogus, Content Usage Ticket Selection Chest, Rare Theostone Chest, Skin Chest)
Twitch Drops page: the Black Conical Hat reward shows the game's own name in every language
Pet map: spawn points within the range the game announces monsters in (about 55 m) disappear when no monster stands there, instead of staying as dots in the background
the pet map no longer shows spawn points without a monster within the range the game announces monsters in
Servers: ids 1001-1018 and 2001-2018 are the Taiwan version (NC's own list), shown as "Taiwan - Azphel" instead of "Azphel [2006]"
Sessions: a Save all button writes every finished session into a folder, one file each, with the rotation and replay data if ticked (requested by a player in a GitHub issue)

Runs waiting for the NC check no longer starve behind the oldest ones: every round looks at the next batch of waiting uploads, and a player NC found a character for but could not settle is asked again after 6 hours instead of 3 days
Website: on the Runs tab each run has a row of its own between the title and the group, with a framed "View run" button, the number of fights and the average and best iDPS
a second start of the program no longer opens a second window (and a second pet overlay that cannot be closed) but brings the running one to the front
the timetable steps aside like the other overlays while the game is behind another program or a game menu is open (inventory and the like)
Client: the pet overlay says the level is unknown, not 'not collected yet', while the pet list is only the saved one of an earlier session; a level-up message adds a pet the saved list did not know
Website: a code signing policy page (/code-signing-policy) linked from the footer of every page, in preparation for free signing of the installer

Client: a player the meter knows by no name and has seen with one single hit is no row in the list (open world strangers), and the minimize and close buttons of every window are drawn lines, not a text glyph (the cross showed only half in some installs)
Website: the download page names the code signing provider (SignPath Foundation) and links the policy
Client: the text of the removed learned-recipes switch is gone from the texts
Website: fight detail pages are addressed by player name and server (/participants/sidy-kaisinel-51379) instead of a bare id
Website: the runs tab shows one card per run (3-4 bosses) with its own View run button and the group of the run

the direction of a life-steal hit is read after the amount restored (it was misread on about 1 hit in 100), the killing blow of a death is the hit with the skill the game names instead of the last hit before it, the instance timer is read for later
Website: the technical article /how-it-works is translated into all ten site languages
Client: the login dump is switched off; server: an identical upload is taken once, timelines are stored compressed and uploads are packed after 6 hours
Client: the crafting tool's recipe search can show only the recipes the character has learned (read from the login list), on by default
Website: the encounter page lists the chain skills of each player: how often the follow-up skill came within its window (taken of used), also when it was never used

Client: the pet map's own position is a fresh exact report for 4 s and then the middle of the monsters and players that moved around him (12 m off instead of 24 m after 5 to 15 s, measured on four recordings); new test mode aion2-position-check
Client: the assist overlay and window show the chain skills the game has just opened (3 s window, from the chain frames) above the cooldowns
Client and website: the uploader's own turned-down skill inputs (a key pressed during an animation) go along with the time axis and show as red marks and a count in the group timeline
Website: a second filter on the boss and dungeon statistics by combat power (known for nearly every run, where the gear score is known for about half of them)

Client: the legion list of the login (the game's own record of each member's name, class, level and server) sets the members' home servers and goes online with the profile upload, with the legion's name; new test mode aion2-frame-dump

Client and website: the focus of each player (time with the boss selected and with anything else, and the target changes, from the game's target frames) goes along with the time axis and shows as a table on the encounter page
Client: a crafting level-up teaches the recipes of that level to the learned-recipes filter, and the recipe tree counts only the listed recipes
Client: the checklist shows the week's season mission points (of 8,000) from the achievements frame; monsters on the pet map move with the movement frames
Client: the character window lists how many titles, wings and teleporters the character owns
Client: the dummy test's comparison shows how many chain skills each run took and how many inputs the server turned down
Client: the target-of-target block follows the target an entity has selected (target frames) until it changes or drops it
Client: hovering a skill in the rotation timeline tells whether its chain follow-up was taken in time

Website: the skill table of the boss statistics has columns for how often a skill's chain follow-up was taken and the average skill level of the characters; the chain figures are worked out when a time axis is stored
Client and website: the effects the players put on the boss (uptime, who gave them, when) go along with a boss fight and show as a panel on the encounter page; the dry-run mode works again
Client: the fight replay map also follows the other monsters the group fought (the ones hit most, up to twelve) as small markers

Client and website: the own ranks the game's ranking window showed (Abyss, Nightmare, Transcendence, Arena, Ascension Rite: rank, change, points, stats) go online with the own profile and show on a Rankings tab of the player page
Client: on the replay map the own character's spot between two readings is marked as an estimate (dashed ring and a note), as the server sends no running position of one's own character

Client: the recorder has debug points (aion2-record <file> --points): a frame of an opcode nobody has described gives two tones and a line with its time in a points file next to the recording; new test mode aion2-opcode-census
Website: the privacy page says what the client reads (only what the game server sends to your computer), what the profile switches send, and names the legion list and the own ranks
Client: the switch for other players' profiles names the members of your own legion
Client: a monster that never moves is on the replay map too - the place it appeared at is the first point of its track, and it stays there until it dies

Client: the privacy policy is asked in the first-start wizard and once for installs that never answered; declined means no upload at all and a restricted meter (damage list only, no Twitch or announcements, only the checklist, stat calculator, attributes, loot, crafting, schedule, design and network tools); an upload switch asks again; 'profiles of other players' is now 'data of other players'

Website and client: the privacy text about what the client reads and uploads is set in paragraphs and bullet lines (the page keeps the line breaks) with a plainer heading; the privacy page now says that the server is in Germany and the processing falls under the GDPR, that no data is sold, passed on or used for advertising, that this is a non-commercial fan project paid for privately, and that positions of other players go online only with the replay upload and only when "data of other players" is switched on (this replaces the earlier statement that they are never uploaded); a duplicated section key had hidden the "what the client reads" section

Client and website server: a new button next to Upload sends the paths of a boss fight for the replay (the own character's, the boss's and the monsters', other players' only with 'data of other players'); the replay window can fetch what the other clients of the fight sent and fills the map with it

Client and website: turned-down skill inputs are no longer read, uploaded or shown (red marks on the fight page, the dummy test line and the sentence in the privacy text are gone); the German privacy text says 'als du das Ranglisten-Fenster geöffnet hattest'

Client and website: the privacy text is set as paragraphs and bullet items with the further lines of an item indented under its first word and a gap between items; the first-start wizard is as wide and tall as its content needs (no scrolling on a 1080p screen)
Client: the first-start wizard has pages with Next and Back - language, privacy policy, the uploads (dropped when the policy is declined) and ready to start - and is as big as its biggest page needs

Client: the last page of the first-start wizard is a checklist with a green tick and a ? tooltip per step - Npcap installed (with a download button if not) and waiting for the character - lists the characters of the account with faction, server, name, class, level and the time of recognition, and Finish stays locked until the character is recognised
Client: the first-start wizard tells you to log in again when it waits for the character
Client: the Npcap download button in the first-start wizard is slimmer, so its list row is no taller than the others
Client: characters that a login showed on another server stay known on this PC (a login lists only its own server's account), so the first-start wizard also lists them - nothing of it is uploaded

Client: the loot tool counted no pickups - in the game's frame for a drop leaving the ground the last byte 1 means picked up (all 1,546 drops of the two own characters), the tool read 0; all drops of one frame are read, not only the first
Client: the crafting tool lists only the recipes the character has learned, as a rule - the switch for it is gone (all recipes show only while no login list is known yet)

Client: the character list of a game session's first login (0x1536, the same list as the 0x2636 of a return to the character selection) is read too, so the characters and the account key are known at once, not only after the first return to the selection

privacy consent and a first-start wizard with pages, replay upload, own ranks tab, chain, focus and effect tables, the characters at the first login; loot pickups are counted again, the crafting tool lists only learned recipes; login dump off, a smaller database
Website: each session on the Runs tab of a player page has a "View run" button that opens the last fight of the session
Client: the player data (item level, combat power, worn pieces) of another player's details sit on a tab "Player" of their own, so the damage and the player's data are looked at apart

Client: the players met in an arena go online by themselves ten seconds after the fight (with the settings "profiles of other players" and "upload my profile" on); from the 10 against 10 arena only name, class, faction, server and legion, so the server can fill them in from NC's page
the player data of another player on a tab of its own; the players met in an arena go online after the fight
Client: the details of a player show what his summons did as a tile "Summons" (its share of his damage, the amount in the tooltip), for a Spiritmaster's spirits and a Sorcerer's walls
the details of a player show the share of his damage that came from his summons
Client: the self-test of the boss spawn frame used the wrong entity numbers (the frames carry 17998 and 41941), which made the whole self-test report a failure since 1.13.6

Client: the arena's refills at the start of a round and between rounds (full HP and MP, three nameless system skills) are no longer counted as damage a player did to himself, which had inflated the damage shown for the arena by up to half
the arena no longer counts its refills between rounds as damage

Client: the hits of a Sorcerer's summon or ground effect are never left on an own row - a summon is no longer taken for its own owner, and a Fire Wall or Cold Storm whose spawn was missed goes to the party's only Sorcerer in an instance
a Sorcerer's summons and ground effects no longer show up as extra Player rows

Client: the texts of the other player's details (item level, combat power, the slot names, the 10 against 10 chip and note) are translated into all languages, the slot names and terms as the game client writes them
the details of another player are translated into every language

Client: the player details of another player list the rest of his equipment and the exact enchant as aiondps.com holds it (belt, rings, bracelets, amulet, runes, arcana), asked in the background once the window is open
the details of another player fill in the rest of his equipment from aiondps.com
Backend: a player NC knows but the check could not match is asked again after three days instead of thirty (his class or profile may have arrived since)

Backend: the check against NC no longer takes the class of a crowd bystander (no damage, a small heal) for his own, and a player on a server beyond the live ones ("Ludra [2111]") is searched in the region of his server id

Backend: a player whose client reports a server id that names no server no longer lands on the uploader's server, and a second row of a character we already hold on his real server is merged into it instead of staying a conflict
Client: the hide-during-menus setting says when it is paused and names the unlocked overlay
Client: the party roster's second server id counts only when it names a server (numbers like 1801, 2819 and 2823 passed the range check and put players on servers that do not exist)

Client: the second server id of a party roster member is read past the marker byte that some frames put in front of it (Munin 2313 was taken for 2305, 2307 or 2311, Zemurru 2315 for 2817, 2819 or 2823)

Client: the player details show what the game tells of another player (level, item level, combat power, the worn pieces with their enchant); in the 10 against 10 arena, where the game evens everybody out, the combat power is not shown (chip "10 vs 10 · evened out") and players first met there go online with name, class, faction, server and legion only
Backend: the page NC shows of a player who stands in the 10 against 10 arena (the fixed combat power 397,228 and level 20 skills) is not stored; it is looked at again after fifteen minutes
the player details of another player show their level, item level, combat power and worn pieces; the 10 against 10 arena gets its own chip and its players are never taken at their evened-out values

Client: the check for updates at start works again (it failed silently on a wrong thread at every start, so an update only came after five minutes or a click on "Check for updates"); at start it stays quiet when you are up to date and asks "a new version is available, install it? No / Yes" before downloading one
the check for updates at start works again and asks before it installs a new version
Website: the two legal links in the footer (Privacy policy, Terms of use) sit side by side instead of stacked

Website: player pages carry equipment, attributes, wings, pet, titles and Daevanion boards as text and stay out of the index while they have neither runs nor gear; removed players and legions answer 410 instead of 404

Saving the settings no longer ends the meter when Windows refuses to replace the settings file for a moment (virus scanner, cloud sync): it is tried again a few times, and a write that still fails is logged and written again with the next change
Website: the Runs tab of player pages groups fights into sessions with a tile per fight, iDPS against the personal best and a filter by kind of content
Website: Runs tab times in the 24-hour clock with day-first dates, also in English
Website: participant page with player card left and skill tables right; changelog
Website: all times use the 24-hour clock and English dates are written day first

Website: the run comparison picker lists each run with everyone who played in it (class-coloured, your group highlighted, details on click) and filters by My group or one player of your group, sorted by newest, fastest or highest iDPS
Website: run comparison picker: date column fits on one line, class dots keep their full colour for players outside your group
Website: run comparison picker: bright, clearly distinct class colours
